answer: Entry needs seaweed harvester licence: a licence the marine body renews after cut shore seasons. Each of 124 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. The relic check runs in the open: 124 fakes pay the full price 124 times, one honest agent pays once, and the raven trail in the ledger makes the pigment cost visible to everyone.
